statement.p: A function with parameters a and b is given below. Describe the critical points and possible points of inflection of f in terms of a and b. Assume a, b > 0. f(x) = \dfrac{a}{x^2 + b^2}
(Separate multiple values by commas. Enter NONE if there are no values.)

solution.p: Use the Quotient Rule to find f' and f''. Set each equal to zero and solve to answer the problem. f'(x) = -\dfrac{2ax}{(x^2 + b^2)^2} = 0 \;\Rightarrow\; x = 0.f''(x) = \dfrac{6ax^2 -2ab^2}{(x^2 + b^2)^3} = 0 \;\Rightarrow\; x^2 = \dfrac{b^2}{3} \;\Rightarrow\; x = \pm \dfrac{b}{\sqrt{3}}.
